channel.title: The FCP AI Toolkit Journal
channel.description: Product updates, release notes and a look at what is coming next for FCP AI Toolkit.

item.title: FCP AI-Toolkit 1.1.1 is out: 1.1, plus two fixes
item.description: 1.1.1 is on the Mac App Store with Smart Cache, caption editing, Smart Search and about 100 languages. The extra “.1” is for two bugs we fixed just in time.

item.title: Coming in 1.1: less repetition, more control.
item.description: Smart Cache, lasting caption corrections, transcript search, and 100 Whisper-model languages with Auto Detect. Here is what we are preparing next.

item.title: Meet FCP AI-Toolkit 1.0. From speech to animated titles.
item.description: Our first release brings local AI transcription and five Motion title templates into your Final Cut Pro workflow.
